name: Drakan
source:
An easygoing half-dragon girl who takes very little in life seriously. All she wants to do is have fun, and make friends. Despite her straightforward and assertive personality, Drakan is easy to get along with, forgiving, and will happily go with the flow. 

Being a half-dragon, Drakan is frightfully powerful, and she possesses a vast amount of knowledge which scholars would kill to get their hands on.

She is a 1st year student in class 1-D of Amadronia Magic Academy.
